efficiency.definition: crest_V / (N * U_charge_V); voltage transfer, not energy efficiency

model_quality.scope: Dataset aggregate; not an error bound or accuracy score for this input

observed_accuracy.reason: A matched measured result is required to assess this input's accuracy

performance.interpretation: Computed values are predictions. Target mismatch is not model accuracy; dataset validation does not establish this setup's measured result.
